The husband becomes or shams to become transform the adult into the baby (shaves his beard off, knocks out his teeth, grasps an axe to cut his feet off). The disgraced guest runs away
description_en_google: A person endowed with (spiritual) power comes in the evening to a woman. When there is a knock at the door, the woman, having agreed in advance with her husband, orders the guest to lie down in the cradle and replies to the entered husband that their son is in the cradle. He begins to turn an adult into a baby or threatens to do it: shaves his beard, knocks out his teeth, grabs an ax to chop off his legs. Disgraced and exhausted guest runs away
description_ru: Наделенное (духовной) властью лицо приходит вечером к женщине. Когда раздается стук в дверь, женщина, договорившись заранее с мужем, велит гостю лечь в колыбель и отвечает вошедшему мужу, что в колыбели их сын. Тот начинает превращать взрослого в младенца или грозит это сделать: сбривает бороду, выбивает зубы, хватает топор отрубить ноги. Опозоренный и измученный гость убегает

name_en: The lover, the husband and the guest
description_en: Before coming in, a guest gets to notice that the housewife is with her lover. When the husband comes home, the guest pretends to possess magic object or the like that helps him to reveal where the good food and the lover are hidden
description_en_google: Before entering, the guest notices the owner in the house with her lover. When the husband arrives, the guest pretends that he is a clairvoyant and indicates to the husband where the lover and the food prepared for him are hidden
description_ru: Прежде, чем зайти, гость замечает в доме хозяйку с любовником. Когда приходит муж, гость делает вид, что он ясновидец и указывает мужу, где спрятаны любовник и приготовленная для того еда

name_en: Guest runs away from the host
description_en: In the absence of the host, the guest is told that the host is going to kill or to maim him. The guest runs away, the host runs after him with good intentions but the guest believes that the received warning had a reason
description_en_google: While the owner is gone, the guest is told that he is going to kill or maim him, presenting imaginary evidence. The returning owner is going to stop the fleeing guest, and he is convinced that he was warned for a reason
description_ru: Пока хозяина нет, гостю говорят, что тот собирается его убить или искалечить, предъявляя мнимые доказательства. Вернувшийся хозяин собирается остановить убегающего гостя, а тот убеждается, что его предупредили не зря

name_en: Lover runs away from the husband
description_en: A farmhand (a young son of the peasant) arranges a situation a series of tricks to the love affair between the wife of his master and another man. The wife is going to bring food outdoor to her lover but gets to her husband. Seeing the master coming with an axe (stones, etc.), the lover believes, that he is going to attack him and runs away
description_en_google: The worker (the young son of the owner) arranges the dishes prepared by the hostess for the lover working in the field to the owner, and when the owner goes to a person he does not know about, this is his wife's lover, he thinks that the husband is going to kill him and fleeing
description_ru: Работник (юный сын хозяина) подстраивает так, что кушанья, приготовленные хозяйкой для работающего в поле любовника, достаются хозяину, а когда хозяин направляется к человеку, о котором он не знает, что это любовник его жены, тот думает, что муж идет его убивать и спасается бегством

description_en: The servant is asked to prepare a goose (chicken, etc.), eats one leg and maintains that the goose had only one leg enforcing his point by showing geese who stand on one leg. The master shoots away the geese so that they use both legs. Usually the servant replies that if he had frightened the roasted goose, it would have showed its second leg as well
description_en_google: The servant gives the master a fried bird, in which one leg has already been eaten. He orders to look at chickens, geese, etc., which stand on one leg. When they run away, it is clear that each has two legs. A servant usually says that if the master had scared a fried goose, he would have shown the other leg
description_ru: Слуга подает господину жареную птицу, у которой одна нога уже съедена. Велит посмотреть на кур, гусей и т.п., которые стоят на одной ноге. Когда те убегают, видно, что у каждого две ноги. Обычно слуга говорит, что если бы хозяин вспугнул жареного гуся, тот тоже показал бы вторую ногу

name_en: Pieces of clothes thrown to pursuer
description_en: Pursued by demonic creature (usually a whale or walrus), people throw behind piece by piece children’s or woman’s clothes. These attract the pursuer’s attention, he loses time, the runaways escape
description_en_google: Running away from the pursuer, the man consistently undresses and throws garments behind him. The pursuer loses time picking them up.
description_ru: Убегая от преследователя, человек последовательно раздевается и бросает позади себя предметы одежды. Преследователь теряет время, подбирая их

name_en_google: Escape from the husband of the animal
description_en: Seriously of for fun, a girl or a woman names an animal or remains of an animal as her husband or steps on the animal’s bones. The animal (revives and) carries her away. Her human husband or brother comes after her and they run away. The animal husband pursues them but abandons the chase or dies
description_en_google: A girl or woman (for various reasons, jokingly or seriously) calls the husband the animal or the remains of the animal or stepping on the bones, refers to them. The animal (comes to life and) carries it away. Her husband is a man or a brother comes for her, both flee, the husband of an animal pursues them, but stops chasing or dies
description_ru: Девушка или женщина (по разным причинам, в шутку или всерьез) называет мужем животное или останки животного либо наступая на кости, обращается к ним. Животное (оживает и) уносит ее. Ее муж-человек или брат приходит за ней, оба спасаются бегством, муж-животное преследует их, но прекращает погоню или гибнет

description_en: Treasure, or the like, is thrown back to tempt pursuer to delay
description_en_google: The evader throws or creates behind himself objects that the pursuer, losing time, collects, eats or destroys, although they do not interfere with his progress.
description_ru: Убегающий бросает или создает позади себя предметы, которые преследователь, теряя время, собирает, поедает или уничтожает, хотя они не мешают его продвижению

name_en: Relatives do not open the door for the girl
description_en: A girl or young woman runs away from the demonic person, knocks at the door of her house but her relatives do not open the door and she is devoured by the demon. (Musical instrument is made from her hair or bowels)
description_en_google: A girl, a young woman runs away from a demonic character; she has time to reach the house, but her relatives do not unlock. The pursuer finds and eats her. (From her hair or guts make a musical instrument)
description_ru: Девушка, молодая женщина убегает от демонического персонажа; она успевает добежать до дому, но родные не отпирают. Преследователь находит и съедает ее. (Из ее волос или кишок делают музыкальный инструмент)

name_en: Animals carry hero away from a demon
name_en_google: The animals are being taken away from the demon.
description_en: A girl or a boy gets to demonic person. Sitting on the back of domestic animal (usually a calf, a bull) the girl (boy) escapes from the demon who pursues her (him). Usually several different animals in succession try to carry the girl away but the demon overtakes them and only the last animal brings her home
description_en_google: Девушка или юноша попадают к демоническому существу. Пленница (пленник) садится верхом на домашнее животное (обычно теленка, быка), которому удается уйти от погони. Обычно животные разных видов последовательно пытаются спасти пленницу, но лишь последнему это удается
description_ru: Девушка или юноша попадают к демоническому существу. Пленница (пленник) садится верхом на домашнее животное (обычно теленка, быка), которому удается уйти от погони. Обычно животные разных видов последовательно пытаются спасти пленницу, но лишь последнему это удается

name_en_google: The fugitive and the pursuer change shape
description_en: A fugitive turns in succession into different animals or objects. A pursuer does the same, every time becoming an animal or a person who is dangerous for the fugitive in his given guise
description_en_google: The runaway character consistently takes on the appearance of various creatures or objects; the pursuer also changes his appearance, each time turning into the one who is dangerous for the pursued in his given appearance
description_ru: Убегающий персонаж последовательно принимает облик различных существ или объектов; преследователь также меняет свой облик, каждый раз превращаясь в того, кто опасен для преследуемого в его данном облике

description_en: Animal, fish or person wounded by hero runs or swims away, usually with the man's projectile in his or her body. Local doctors are not able to cure the wound (usually because they do not see the projectile). The hero or his companion comes to the place where the wounded one lives and cures him or her (usually extracting his projectile from the wound)
description_en_google: An animal, fish or an anthropomorphic character wounded by a hero runs away or swims away — usually with a hook, harpoon, arrow, or other weapon or hunting or fishing device stuck in the body; local healers cannot cure a creature / character (usually because they don’t see a wounded object); the hero or his companion comes to the village of the wounded and successfully heals him (usually, taking out the object that has caused the wound)
description_ru: Раненные героем животное, рыба или антропоморфный персонаж убегает или уплывает – обычно с крючком, гарпуном, стрелой или иным застрявшим в теле орудием охоты или рыбной ловли; местные лекари не могут вылечить существо/персонажа (обычно потому, что не видят нанесшего рану предмета); герой или его товарищ приходит в селение раненого и успешно лечит его (обычно, вынув нанесший рану предмет)

name_en_google: The requirement to return the harpoon
description_en: A person takes an object belonging to him from another and loses it; the owner requests the return of the item; the hero goes after him to another world, usually finds and brings the lost
description_en_google: A person takes an item from another and loses it; the owner requires the return of the item; the hero goes to another world after him, usually finds and brings the lost
description_ru: Человек берет у другого принадлежащий тому предмет и теряет его; владелец требует возвратить предмет; герой уходит за ним в иной мир, обычно находит и приносит потерянное

description_en: An antagonist makes a demand to the hero which is correct in form but really is unjustified. The hero fulfills the claims or is punished. Now antagonist takes an object or animal possessed by the hero, is unable to give it back and is punished
description_en_google: The antagonist makes the hero formally justified, but in fact unfair demands. The hero performs them either punished by the antagonist. Then the antagonist takes the item or animal belonging to the hero, but cannot return and is punished as or more severely.
description_ru: Антагонист предъявляет герою формально оправданные, но по сути несправедливые требования. Герой выполняет их либо наказан антагонистом. Затем антагонист берет предмет или животное принадлежащие герою, но не может вернуть и наказан столь же или более сурово

name_en: In search of lost object to the other world
description_en: In search of a lost object, usually carried away by water or wind, a girl or (rare) a boy comes to a powerful person, gets the object back and/or is rewarded. The object is related to the everyday life, it has no ritual significance and is not a weapon
description_en_google: A girl, a girl, or (rarely) a boy loses a household item, usually blown away by water or wind. In search of loss, she (he) gets to powerful characters, returns an item and / or receives valuables.
description_ru: Девушка, девочка или (редко) мальчик теряет бытовой предмет, обычно унесенный водой или ветром. В поисках пропажи она (он) попадает к могущественным персонажам, возвращает предмет и/или получает ценности

description_en: Anthropomorphic beings have huge ears (use them for blankets, umbrellas, etc.)
description_en_google: People have disproportionately large ears: they are covered like a blanket, used as an umbrella, they can step on, etc.
description_ru: Люди имеют несоразмерно огромные уши: накрываются ими как одеялом, используют как зонтик, могут на них наступить и т.п.

description_en: An (animal) person gives a signal (special song, etc.) to his relative or friend who lets him or her in. Antagonist imitates the person's voice or guise and the relative lets him in
description_en_google: Every time a departed character returns, he or she has a little song, etc. gives a conditional signal to his relative who has remained at home (usually the child) or a friend, who lets him in. The antagonist impersonates himself, departed, imitating his voice, showing, allegedly, his hand, etc.
description_ru: Каждый раз, когда ушедший персонаж возвращается, он или она песенкой и т.п. подает условный сигнал своему оставшемуся дома родственнику (обычно – ребенку) или другу, тот впускает к себе. Антагонист выдает себя за ушедшего, подражая его голосу, показывая, якобы, его руку и т.п.

description_en: A predator or ogre swallows people or animals. Goat opens the ogre’s belly open, usually the swallowed ones come out alive
description_en_google: Predator or cannibal swallows people and animals. A goat (rarely a sheep) rips out his belly, usually those swallowed go out alive
description_ru: Хищник или людоед проглатывает людей и животных. Коза (редко – овца) распарывает ему брюхо, обычно проглоченные выходят живыми

description_en: To make himself unrecognizable by the victim, a predator or ogre modifies his throat or tongue mechanically (oils or burns it, asks blacksmith to remake it, etc.)
description_en_google: So that the victim does not recognize him, the predator, the ogre makes his voice thinner by mechanical means - lubricates the throat (tongue) with fat, burns with a hot stone, iron, bites the ants, turns to the blacksmith, etc.
description_ru: Чтобы жертва не узнала его, хищник, людоед делает свой голос тоньше с помощью механических средств - смазывает горло (язык) жиром, прижигает раскаленным камнем, железом, подвергает укусам муравьев, обращается к кузнецу и т.п.

description_en: To make himself unrecognizable by the victim, a predator or ogre demonstrates clothes, limb, etc. that look like clothes or limb of his victim's mother, etc.
description_en_google: So that the victim did not recognize him and unlocked the door, the predator, the ogre shows a piece of clothing, a hand, a paw, forcing the victim to believe that a mother, teacher, etc. came.
description_ru: Чтобы жертва не узнала его и отперла дверь, хищник, людоед показывает часть одежды, руку, лапу, заставляя жертву поверить, что пришла мать, воспитательница и т.п.

description_en: Fox has a child or children (usually adopts a lamb, foal, etc.), cares for it. Wolf finds and eats it, the fox revenges on him
description_en_google: A fox has a child, usually adopted (she takes care of a lamb, a foal, etc.), a wolf or a bear kills him, a fox takes revenge
description_ru: У лисы – ребенок, обычно приемный (она заботится о ягненке, жеребенке и т.п.), волк или медведь его убивают, лиса мстит

description_en: A person (a girl, a small boy) gets into the water and remains there. Antagonist lures him out imitating his father's or sibling's voice
description_en_google: The character (girl, boy) is in the water, the antagonist entices him to the shore, imitating the voice of his father, brother or sister
description_ru: Персонаж (девушка, мальчик) оказывается в воде, антагонист выманивает его на берег, подражая голосу отца, брата или сестры

description_en: Person is or becomes black and has to sit in the water till becomes white. An antagonist carries him or her away
description_en_google: The character is black and must sit in the water until he turns white. Antagonist takes him away
description_ru: Персонаж черен и должен сидеть в воде, пока не побелеет. Антагонист уносит его

description_en: A gourd proves to be a cannibal or grows from remains of a monster
description_en_google: Pumpkin turns out to be a monster absorber and / or grows from the remains of a monster
description_ru: Тыква оказывается чудовищем-поглотителем и/или вырастает из останков чудовища

name_en_google: The demon is coming to the fire of the hunter
description_en: A hunter spends night in a desolate place. A demon comes to his fire. When the demon falls asleep or goes away for a while, the hunter puts his clothes over a log and hides nearby. When the demon attacks the log taking it for the man, the hunter wounds or kills the demon
description_en_google: A demonic character approaches a person's fire. A person first leaves a block of wood in his place, hides himself. The character rushes to the block, taking him for a sleeping person, usually a hunter kills or wounds a demon
description_ru: К костру человека подходит демонический персонаж. Человек предварительно оставляет вместо себя чурбан, сам прячется. Персонаж бросается на чурбан, приняв его за спящего человека, обычно охотник убивает или ранит демона

description_en: In a non-human world objects of everyday life have appearance of animals and monsters, mainly fish, amphibians and reptiles
description_en_google: Items of everyday use have the form of fish, invertebrates, reptiles, dangerous predators or objects turn into these animals under special circumstances
description_ru: Предметы повседневного обихода имеют вид рыб, беспозвоночных, рептилий, опасных хищников либо предметы превращаются в этих животных при особых обстоятельствах

description_en: A demonic being swallows a multitude of people and animals. When it is killed and cut open, the swallowed ones come out alive or are revived
description_en_google: The character swallows a lot of people and / or animals. In the end, his stomach is ripped open, those who are swallowed unharmed go outside or are taken and revived
description_ru: Персонаж проглатывает множество людей и/или животных. В конце концов ему вспарывают живот, проглоченные невредимыми выходят наружу или извлечены и оживлены

description_en: A demonic being swallows a person or (in African versions) a multitude of people and animals. Hero kills the monster but cutting open its body, injures a person who was inside. Usually this person is offended and finds opportunity to kill the hero
description_en_google: The character swallows a person or (in the African versions) a lot of people and animals, the hero kills the monster, and by cutting it, accidentally injures one of those swallowed. Usually, he is offended and when swallowed come out, causes damage to the hero or destroys him.
description_ru: Персонаж проглатывает человека или (в африканских версиях) множество людей и животных, герой убивает чудовище, а разрезав его, случайно ранит одного из проглоченных. Обычно тот обижен и когда проглоченные выходят наружу, наносит герою ущерб или губит его

description_en: A stomach (spleen) cut out of the body of a domestic animal or fowl becomes a voracious monster
description_en_google: Out of the body of a pet or bird, the stomach (spleen) is a voracious monster.
description_ru: Вынутый из тела домашнего животного или птицы желудок (селезенка) оказывается прожорливым монстром

description_en: Old man and woman make a child of clay (wood, straw). The doll becomes alive, devours everybody who comes across. Usually a goat (sheep) breaks it, swallowed people come our alive
description_en_google: Elderly spouses make a child out of clay (wood, straw). The doll comes to life, consistently eats everyone he sees. Usually the goat (sheep) breaks it, swallowed go out alive
description_ru: Пожилые супруги делают ребенка из глины (дерева, соломы). Кукла оживает, последовательно съедает всех, кого видит. Обычно коза (баран) разбивает ее, проглоченные выходят живыми

description_en: The sky dwellers fish human beings who live on earth with a line and a hook
description_en_google: Sky dwellers or shamans catch or want to catch people on the hook, net, loop, etc., drag them to the sky (up somewhere) as the fishermen pull fish out of the water
description_ru: Обитатели неба или шаманы ловят или хотят поймать земных людей на крючок, в сеть, в петлю и т.п., утаскивают их в небо (куда-то вверх) как рыбаки вытаскивают из воды рыбу

description_en: A boy is born having only half of a body or only a head. Ultimately he obtains normal body
description_en_google: A bodily inferior boy is born (tiny, one head, half body, etc.). After a series of adventures, he gains bodily fullness.
description_ru: Рождается телесно неполноценный мальчик (крохотный, одна голова, половина тела и т.п.). После ряда приключений он обретает телесную полноту

description_en: A girl who rejected many suitors marries a handsome man and walks with him to his place. Her husband proves to be a cannibal demon
description_en_google: The girl, long rejected suitors, goes for a handsome man. He leads her to himself and turns out to be a demon, a werewolf. The girl hardly escapes
description_ru: Девушка, долго отвергавшая женихов, выходит за красавца. Он ведет ее к себе и оказывается демоном, оборотнем. Девушка с трудом спасается

name_en: The youngest one saves siblings from demon
description_en: A group of young people comes to a demon. The youngest brother of sister or a sick and invalid person who often accompanies the others against their wish saves them all
description_en_google: A group of boys or girls comes to the demon locus. Younger brother or sister or a sick, worthless character, who often went with others against their will, saves them all
description_ru: Группа юношей или девушек приходит в локус демона. Младшие брат или сестра либо больной, негодный персонаж, нередко пошедший с другими вопреки их желанию, спасает их всех

description_en: A member (usually the youngest) of a group of boys or girls gets with them to a cannibal. The cannibal plans to kill people when they fall asleep. The youngest boy or girl every time answers the cannibal why he or she is still awake and forces him or her to be engaged into different activities instead of killing the sleeping people. Brothers (sisters) run away and return home
description_en_google: One (usually the youngest) of a group of young men or girls (children) ends up with them into the house of an ogre or cannibal. The ogre is going to kill those who came when they fall asleep. The younger one consistently responds to the ogre, why he does not sleep, forcing him to carry out all new errands instead of attacking the sleeping ones. Brothers (sisters) flee and flee
description_ru: Один (обычно младший) из группы юношей или девушек (детей) попадает вместе с ними в дом людоеда или людоедки. Людоед собирается убить пришедших, когда те заснут. Младший последовательно отвечает людоеду, почему он не спит, заставляя его выполнять все новые поручения вместо того, чтобы напасть на спящих. Братья (сестры) бегут и спасаются

description_en: Getting a task or by his own initiative, a trickster several times comes to a person (usually an ogre) and steals in succession objects in his possession or members of his family
description_en_google: Having received a task or on his own initiative, the sly one penetrates the character’s house several times (usually the cannibal), each time taking one of the things or one of his family members
description_ru: Получив задание или по собственной инициативе, хитрец несколько раз проникает в дом персонажа (обычно – людоеда), каждый раз унося одну из вещей или одного из членов его семьи

name_en: A task: to bring the ogre
description_en: Person has to bring a certain ogre and does it luring the ogre into a cage, a box, etc.
description_en_google: The character gets the task to bring the ogre and executes it, luring him into a box, cage, etc.
description_ru: Персонаж получает задание привести людоеда и выполняет его, заманив того в ящик, клетку и т.п.

name_en: To exchange clothes with ogre's daughters
name_en_google: Swap clothes with the ogre's daughters
description_en: Children or youths (usually a group of brothers) exchange clothes (headgears, ornaments, etc.) with their enemy’s children who kills his or her own children by mistake. Usually brothers get to the ogre or ogress. The youngest advices to exchange places (clothes, headgears, cloaks) with ogre’s sleeping children (usually daughters). The ogre kills his children. Outside of Europe the protagonists can be animals.
description_en_google: Children or young men (usually brothers) change clothes (hats, ornaments) with children of a character that is hostile to them and kills their own children instead of them. Usually the brothers go to a cannibal or ogre. description_en: After breaking some taboo, coming across a strange object or person, people fall asleep and awake blind

description_en_google: Trying to free himself, a grasped character turns into various substances, materials, animals or orders various dangerous animals to attack the person

description_en: Being seized, person changes his or her guise in succession, one of the transformations is into the fire (and also into the water)
description_en_google: Trying to free himself, the captured character gradually changes its appearance, in particular, turning into fire (and water)

description_en_google: Trying to free themselves, the grasped character consistently changes its appearance. The last transformation is a small wooden object (usually a spindle, which must be broken in half)
description_ru: Пытаясь освободиться, схваченный персонаж последовательно меняет свой облик. Последнее превращение – небольшой деревянный предмет (обычно веретено, которое надо сломать пополам)

description_en: Demons (or one of them) attack people and return to their den (usually a cave or tree hollow). People make suffocating fire around the den killing most or all of the demons
description_en_google: Demons (or one of them) attack people and then hide. People destroy the lair of demons and kill all or most of them, building a smoke fire around the shelter of demons
description_ru: Демоны (или один из них) нападают на людей и затем скрываются. Люди уничтожают логово демонов и убивают всех или большинство из них, разведя вокруг убежища демонов дымный огонь

description_en: People adopt a demonic child, girl or woman but discover that this being kills people (in particular babies left in its charge) sucking out their brains or taking out their eyes
description_en_google: By killing demons, people save the life of a child, girl, or woman; living among people, this demon kills people (usually children) left in her or his care
description_ru: Убивая демонов, люди сохраняют жизнь ребенку, девушке или женщине; живя среди людей, этот демон убивает людей (обычно детей), оставленных на ее или его попечение

description_en: During the first initiation supernatural beings teach boys the rituals and kill them for breaking rules related to consumption and distribution of food. In response men kill the supernaturals and reproduce their appearance and/or voices during the rituals
description_en_google: During the first initiation, supernatural beings teach boys rituals and kill for breaking the rules related to the consumption and distribution of food. In response, men kill supernatural characters, reproducing their appearance and / or voices from that time during the rituals
description_ru: Во время первой инициации сверхъестественные существа обучают мальчиков ритуалам и убивают за нарушение правил, связанных с потреблением и распределением пищи. В ответ мужчины убивают сверхъестественных персонажей, воспроизводя с той поры во время ритуалов их облик и/или голоса

description_en: Two girls or young women meet a demon. One or both are not aware of danger. One is eaten up, another escapes
description_en_google: Sisters or friends meet a demon. One or both do not understand the danger. One is eaten or crippled, the second is saved
description_ru: Cестры или подруги встречают демона. Одна или обе не понимают опасности. Одна съедена или искалечена, вторая спасается

name_en: One is eaten up, another escapes
name_en_google: One eaten, the other runs away
description_en: Two or three children get to the house of a demon or the latter comes to their house. They do not know that the person is a cannibal or are not sure about it. The demon eats up one of the children. Another child (children) escapes, the demon pursues him or them and perishes. Usually the demon is a female, and if he is male, his victims do not arouse in him sexual interest
description_en_google: Sisters or a brother and sister find themselves in the same house with an antagonist, whose cannibalism they only guess or do not know at all. Trying to hide his actions, the ogre eats one of the children. The other, or others, flee, the antagonist pursues them and perishes. Usually the antagonist is female, and if masculine, then he does not feel about the victims of sexual interest. (In the Central Andes, the plot could be borrowed in the 19th century from Chinese migrants)
description_ru: Сестры или брат и сестра оказываются в одном доме с антагонистом, о каннибализме которого они лишь догадываются или не знают вообще. Стараясь скрыть свои действия, людоед съедает одного из детей. Другой или другие бегут, антагонист преследует их и гибнет. Обычно антагонист – женского пола, а если мужского, то не испытывающий к жертвам сексуального интереса. (В Центральных Андах сюжет мог быть заимствован в 19 в. от китайских мигрантов)

description_en_google: A person who has eaten an unusual or prohibited meat or fish food, or has touched something forbidden, turns into a reptile or fish
description_ru: Человек, съевший необычную или запрещенную мясную или рыбную пищу либо коснувшийся чего-то запретного, превращается в рептилию или в рыбу

name_en_google: Eating a snake causes a flood

name_en_google: Children are carried to the sky

name_en_google: Let the wolf eat the fool
description_en: A man travels to get know why he is poor (unlucky). Other persons, animals, plants ask him to investigate the reason of their own misfortunes. God (fate) tells that the wolf (bear, lion) should eat the most stupid man. Other problems can be resolved if the queen gets a husband, a treasure is taken from under the fruit tree, etc. The man does not use opportunity to become a king, to receive gold, etc. because did not receive direct instructions to do it. The wolf decides that the man is a real fool and he must eat him
description_en_google: A man goes to find out the cause of their failures. Others also refer their questions to him. God (fate) replies that a predator (a wolf, a lion, a bear) must eat a fool, and to help others, they must dig up treasure, marry a queen, etc. The man refuses to marry, take gold, etc., because he did not receive direct instructions to do so. The predator decides that he will not find anyone more stupid
description_ru: Человек отправляется узнать причину своих неудач. Другие тоже передают с ним свои вопросы. Бог (судьба) отвечает, что хищник (волк, лев, медведь) должен съесть глупца, а чтобы помочь остальным, надо выкопать клад, жениться на царице и т.п. Человек отказывается жениться, взять золото и т.п., ибо не получил прямых указаний это сделать. Хищник решает, что никого глупее он не найдет

description_en: Hero comes to God (Fate, Sun, etc.) and puts questions that asked him to put those whom he met on the way. The ferryman wanted to know for how long he must fulfill his duties. description_en_google: A person comes to ask God (fate, the sun, etc.) the questions that he was asked to ask by those whom he met along the way. Перевозчик через реку спрашивал, когда он освободится от своих обязанностей. Бог отвечает: пусть оставит вместо себя другого человека. Герой сообщает это перевозчику, оказавшись на другом берегу

name_en_google: Absurd actions to lure a character

description_en: Hero escapes from the demon's basket or bag letting stone instead of him
description_en_google: The character runs away from catching him, leaving instead a stone or sand
description_ru: Персонаж убегает от поймавшего его, оставив вместо себя камень или песок

description_en_google: The basket in which the ogre puts people, smeared or filled with resin
description_ru: Корзина, в которую людоедка кладет людей, вымазана или наполнена смолой

description_en_google: The ogre steals fresh corpses from the graves
description_ru: Людоед похищает из могил свежие трупы

name_en_google: Now in the house, then outside
description_en: Person hides from the powerful one now in his house, now outdoors, the powerful cannot catch him
description_en_google: The character hides from the stronger inside the house, then outside, the strong can not grab it
description_ru: Персонаж прячется от более сильного то внутри дома, то снаружи, сильный не может его схватить

description_en_google: A man runs away from the ogre on the ice, the ogre pursues him, licks the blood spilled on the ice, his tongue freezes, he dies, or breaks to death, slipping on ice

description_en: An ogre catches a person and carries his or her prey home but the person escapes on the way. The ogre comes back, this time carries the person to his home. Or the ogre catches a group of children, most of them escape on the way, one is brought to the ogre's place
description_en_google: The demon catches the hero, carries it home, the hero runs off on the way. The demon returns, grabs the hero again and this time brings it to his home. Either the demon grabs, carries several children, they run off along the way, there is only one that the demon brings to his house
description_ru: Демон ловит героя, несет домой, герой по пути убегает. Демон возвращается, снова хватает героя и на этот раз приносит в свой дом. Либо демон хватает, несет нескольких детей, они по пути убегают, остается один, которого демон приносит в свой дом

description_en: Person that has to be eaten up imperceptibly runs away. The master of the house thinks that his wife had eaten the food alone and cuts her belly open
description_en_google: The character destined for eating imperceptibly runs away. The owner of the house thinks that his wife ate him alone and rips her belly
description_ru: Предназначенный на съеденье персонаж незаметно убегает. Хозяин дома думает, что жена одна его съела и вспарывает ей живот

description_en: Step mother or more often father (persuaded by his wife) abandons children in a desolate place. Getting to the ogre or ogress, children (or at least one of them) survive and ultimately achieve success
description_en_google: Stepmother, and often the father (usually at the insistence of the new wife) leaves the children in a deserted place. They get into the house of a cannibal or cannibal, all (or at least one of them) remain alive, succeed
description_ru: Мачеха, а чаще отец (обычно по настоянию новой жены) оставляет детей в безлюдном месте. Они попадают в дом людоеда или людоедки, все (или хотя бы один из них) остаются в живых, добиваются успеха

name_en: Chops are heard, woodcutter is gone
name_en_google: A knock is heard, the lumberjack is gone

description_en_google: The father (stepmother) takes the children to the forest, quietly leaves. So that the children think that he is chopping wood nearby, the father hangs a plank, a pumpkin, etc., which knocks on the wind in the wind
description_ru: Отец (мачеха) заводит детей в лес, незаметно уходит. Чтобы дети думали, что он неподалеку рубит дрова, отец вешает на дерево доску, тыкву и т.п., которая стучит на ветру о ствол

description_en: Walking person creates a trace behind him or her throwing seeds, stones, etc. or the trace is produced because blood drops behind the person. Birds destroy the trace
description_en_google: A man leaves a trail behind him, throwing seeds, pebbles, etc. or leaving a drop of blood. Birds destroy the trail
description_ru: Человек оставляет за собой след, бросая семена, камешки и т.п. или оставляя капли крови. Птицы уничтожают след

name_en: Ogres who come to a feast devour the host
name_en_google: Gathered at the feast eat up the host
description_en: An ogre brings the hero to his house to feast on him together with other ogres. When the guests get to know that the hero has escaped, they devour the host
description_en_google: The ogre catches the hero, calls on the feast of other cannibals. The hero runs away, and the cannibals eat the one who invited them
description_ru: Людоед ловит героя, зовет на пир других людоедов. Герой убегает, а людоеды съедают пригласившего их

name_en: Sister sets out to save her little brother
name_en_google: Sister goes to rescue brother (geese, swans)
description_en: A demon carries away a little boy but his sister finds him, takes and back escapes from the pursuer. Usually the boy has three sisters but only the youngest one is successful
description_en_google: Creatures from another world take away a little boy. Sister takes him and safely leaves the chase. Usually the boy has two or three sisters and only the youngest achieves success.
description_ru: Существа из иного мира уносят маленького мальчика. Сестра забирает его и благополучно уходит от погони. Обычно у мальчика две или три сестры и лишь младшая достигает успеха

name_en_google: Boy fisherman carried away by a witch
description_en: A boy rides in a boat. The witch lures him to the shore and carries to her home. The boy escapes
description_en_google: The boy is swimming in a boat. The witch lures him and carries him away. The boy is saved
description_ru: Мальчик плавает в лодке. Ведьма выманивает его и уносит. Мальчик спасается

name_en: Tree bends down (mice in the ogre’s bag)
name_en_google: The tree is tilting (mice in the ogre bag)
description_en: An ogre puts children (usually they are mice) into his bag, tell a tree (post, etc.) to bend down, hangs the bag on the tree and tells the tree to straighten itself back. Another animal person (usually the fox) releases the children
description_en_google: The ogre catches children (usually mice), puts them in a bag, orders a tree (pole, crossbar in the house) to bend down, hangs up the bag, orders the tree to straighten again, leaves. Another character (usually a fox) orders a tree (pole, etc.) to bend down, frees children
description_ru: Людоед ловит детей (обычно это мыши), кладет в сумку, велит дереву (шесту, перекладине в доме) наклониться, вешает сумку, велит дереву вновь распрямиться, уходит. Другой персонаж (обычно лиса) велит дереву (шесту и т.п.) наклониться, освобождает детей

description_en: Hero escapes from ogre's trap or hides in a shelter. The ogre or ogress roasts and/or eats insects, snakes, excrements, etc. being sure that he or she eats the man
description_en_google: The hero escapes from the demon's trap or continues to remain unscathed in the shelter from which the demons are trying to get him. They devour the excrement of the hero, insects, snakes, etc., not intended for eating, but they think that they are eating the hero
description_ru: Герой убегает из ловушки демона или продолжает оставаться невредимым в убежище, откуда демоны пытаются его достать. Те пожирают экс­кре­менты героя, насекомых, змей и прочее, не предназначенное для еды, но думают, что едят героя

description_en: A man hides in a shelter. An ogre wants him to demonstrate certain parts of his body. The man demonstrates or parts of the body of an animal or some objects. The ogre believes that his adversary is a powerful creature
description_en_google: A demon or strong beast requires that a person show parts of his body. The man is a part of the body of a dead animal or some objects, the enemy believes that he is not a man, but someone powerful
description_ru: Демон или сильный зверей требует, чтобы человек показал отдельные части своего тела. Человек части тела убитого животного или какие-то предметы, противник верит, что перед ним не человек, а некто могущественный

description_en: A man hides in a shelter. An ogre wants him to give certain parts of his body. The man gives the ogre instead parts of the body of a killed animal. The ogre does not understand the deceit, gives in response parts of his own body and dies
description_en_google: The demon requires that the person hiding in the shelter give him separate parts of his body. A man gives the demon parts of the body of a dead animal. The demon does not understand deception and dies, giving back parts of his own body.
description_ru: Демон требует, чтобы спрятавшийся в убежище человек отдавал ему отдельные части своего тела. Человек передает демону части тела убитого животного. Демон не понимает обмана и погибает, отдавая в ответ части собственного тела

name_en: The blind got his sight, the lame got his legs
description_en: A blind man and a lame man live together and help each other. When they got mortally scared or became to fight with each other, their eyes and legs were cured
description_en_google: The blind and deaf (lame) began to live together, helping each other. After mortally scared or in a fight with each other, both got rid of their shortcomings
description_ru: Слепой и глухой (хромой) стали жить вместе, помогая друг другу. После того, как смертельно испугались или подрались друг с другом, оба избавились от своих недостатков

description_en: An ogre or a stronger animal catches a man or a weaker animal or drives him into a small enclosure and goes away for a time leaving a watchman. The hero dupes the watchman, escapes. (Most, though hardly all American cases can have post-Columbian African origin)
description_en_google: A strong character drives the weak into a trap and leaves someone to guard the prey; the weak fool the watchman and run away. (A significant part, although hardly all, of American texts may be of recent African descent)
description_ru: Сильный персонаж загоняет слабого в ловушку и оставляет кого-нибудь сторожить добычу; слабый одурачивает сторожа и убегает. (Значительная часть, хотя вряд ли все, американских текстов может быть недавнего африканского происхождения)

description_en: Person ascends, descends, walks head downward or sees the world upside down
description_en_google: The character goes, rises or descends upside down, or sees the world upside down
description_ru: Персонаж идет, поднимается или спускается вниз головой, либо видит мир перевернутым вверх ногами

description_en_google: The enemy of the hero approaches him upside down or backwards, which gives the hero the opportunity to kill him or escape

description_en_google: A hero (usually somewhere on a dais - on a tree, on a rock, on the edge of a precipice or a well) kills and / or drops one of his opponents down. Other opponents do not recognize the comrade and believe that the slain is the hero they are pursuing.
description_ru: Герой (обычно где-то на возвышении - на дереве, скале, на краю пропасти или колодца) убивает и/или сбрасывает оттуда вниз одного из своих противников. Другие противники не узнают товарища и полагают, что убитый есть преследуемый ими герой

description_en: Body parts of a person or pieces pf his flesh are thrown down successively. Usually, thows who are on the ground take them for game, honey, fish
description_en_google: Separate parts or pieces of the character's body are successively dropped down. Below are usually taken for game, honey, fish

description_en: A person distracts attention of those who come to him or her or pass by and kills them, usually throwing down into a precipice, lake, etc.
description_en_google: The character distracts the attention of those who are coming (passing by) and kills them, usually pushing them somewhere down.
description_ru: Персонаж отвлекает внимание приходящих (проходящих мимо) и убивает их, обычно сталкивая куда-то вниз

name_en_google: The victim is thrown into aquatic animals.

description_en_google: The ogre, the spirit, the beast of prey throws the bodies of their victims down where they are devoured by water
description_ru: Людоед, дух, хищный зверь сбрасывает тела своих жертв вниз, где их пожирают водные существа

name_en_google: Hero flies from the top of the tree

description_en: A monstrous animal is killed or neutralized by stones (or pieces of metal, heavy fruits, etc.) thrown into its maw or anus. The stones are usually burning hot
description_en_google: A terrible creature is killed or neutralized by burning hot stones, pieces of iron, etc., thrown into his mouth or anus. (your stones and guarasu have cold stones) or a creature retreats when it threatens to throw a stone into its mouth

description_en_google: To overcome disaster, hot stones or ashes are thrown into the water.

description_en_google: To neutralize a dangerous enemy, one of the holes in his body is poured caustic or boiling liquid.

name_en_google: Bonfire in the womb of the beast

description_en_google: A monster or a huge animal dies from a fire bred in its womb.

name_en: Person gets his body part back

description_en_google: The character loses its internal organ, part of the body, they are carried away by others; he quietly approaches, takes the lost

name_en: Hero’s companion gets his body part back

name_en_google: The demon comes for part of his body

description_ru: Человек отказывает в пище ближайшим родственникам; в наказание он или его пища меняют свою природу

description_en_google: People who mocked a hero or his son, dragged into the sea, turn into a sea animal either in parts of his body or in parasites
description_ru: Люди, издевавшиеся над героем или над его сыном, утянуты в море, превращаются в морское животное либо в части его тела или в паразитов на шкуре

description_en: A monstrous head pursues luminaries, people or sticks to person's body
description_en_google: Monster head pursues luminaries, people or sticks to another's body
description_ru: Голова-чудовище преследует светила, людей или прилипает к чужому телу

description_en: Rolling head suffers thirst
description_en_google: Rolling head suffers from thirst
description_ru: Катящаяся голова страдает от жажды

name_en: Wife’s headless body pursues her husband
description_en: The beheaded woman pursues her husband while her head pursues her children
description_en_google: The headless body of a woman pursues her husband, and her head pursues her children.

description_en_google: The head, face, or skull is the husband, the bridegroom, or the son of a woman; not dangerous for her, brings wealth, saves people from hunger, etc.

name_en_google: The head of the older sister rolls behind the younger one.

description_en_google: From one of the sisters remains only the head. She goes after another sister or sisters, or they take her with them; eventually the head finds a place where it wants to settle
description_ru: От одной из сестер остается лишь голова. Она катится за другой сестрой или сестрами или те берут ее с собой; в конце концов голова находит место, где хочет обосноваться

name_en: Person stuck in an opening, head is torn off
name_en_google: Severed head stuck in the hole

description_en_google: Two sisters or two brothers are in the house of a demon or in front of an obstacle. One or one crawls through a narrow opening. Another or other is stuck. A brother or sister pulls his or her head, the head comes off
description_ru: Две сестры или двое братьев оказываются в доме демона или перед препятствием. Одна или один пролезает сквозь узкое отверстие. Другая или другой застревает. Брат или сестра тянут его или ее за голову, голова отрывается

description_en: A demonic being demands that a person would carry it permanently, clings to his shoulder or back
description_en_google: The creature requires the other person to wear it all the time, not allowing them to lose themselves.

description_en_google: Several sisters pick up the baby. In their absence, he turns into an adult man, and when they approach, he becomes a child again. Having taken its true appearance, the demon pursues the sisters

description_ru: Беременная женщина ругает Солнце, Дождь или иного могущественного персонажа. Из-за этого ребенок рождается телесно неполноценным. Он обладает магической силой и обычно обретает нормальное тело

name_en: After coming to the sky, the lad gets a normal body
name_en_google: Rising to the sky, acquires bodily fullness
name_ru: Поднявшись на небо, обретает телесную полноту
description_en: A lad with incomplete or grotesque body becomes normal after coming to the sky (coming to God, getting back to the earth)
description_en_google: Having risen to heaven (having met God, having returned from heaven to earth), the physically flawed young man (usually: having half the body) becomes full-fledged
description_ru: Поднявшись на небо (встретившись с Богом, вернувшись с неба на землю), телесно ущербный юноша (обычно: имеющий половину тела) становится полноценным

description_en: Person with half of a body is a chicken (sometimes only by name)
description_en_google: Character with half the body - chicken, chicken. Sometimes it’s just a name, and the character’s appearance is rather anthropomorphic.
description_ru: Персонаж с половиной тела – курица, цыпленок. Иногда это только имя, а облик персонажа скорее антропоморфный

name_en: One leg and one arm: the injured ploughman
description_en: Hero comes across a strong giant (usually a ploughman) with one leg, one arm, one eye. The latter was injured when he met a giant who was much bigger and stronger than he
description_en_google: The hero meets a giant and a strong man (usually a plowman) with one hand, one foot, one eye. He remained crippled after meeting a character who turned out to be much bigger and stronger than him.
description_ru: Герой встречает великана и силача (обычно пахаря) с одной рукой, одной ногой, одним глазом. Тот остался калекой после встречи с персонажем, который оказался намного больше и сильнее его

description_en: A woman turns into demon and pursues her children
description_en_google: Transformed into a demon, a woman pursues her children.
description_ru: Превратившись в демона, женщина преследует своих детей

description_en: Unintentionally, person gets to taste his or her own blood or flesh, likes the taste, turns into a cannibal
description_en_google: The character accidentally tastes blood, after which he devours himself and / or others
description_ru: Персонаж случайно пробует на вкус кровь, после чего пожирает себя самого и/ли других

name_en_google: The demon comes to life by touch
description_en: A man kills an ogre. When he later comes and touches the ogre's remains, the latter revives
description_en_google: A man kills a demon, and when, over time, touches his remains, he comes to life
description_ru: Человек убивает демона, а когда по прошествии времени дотрагивается до его останков, тот оживает

description_en: Person transforms humans into monsters or animals secretly putting prohibited meat, grease or eggs into their food or provoking them to use a particular object
description_en_google: One person, wanting to harm another, imperceptibly gives him to eat a certain food or use a certain object. As a result, he suffers damage, dies or experiences metamorphosis.
description_ru: Один человек, желая причинить вред другому, незаметно дает ему съесть определенную пищу или воспользоваться определенным предметом. В результате тот терпит ущерб, гибнет или испытывает метаморфозу

name_en: Mouth from the earth to the sky
description_en: Monster's upper lip (fang, horn, etc.) touches the sky, lower touches the ground
description_en_google: One lip (one canine, horn, etc.) of a creature reaches the sky, the other is dragged along the ground
description_ru: Одна губа (один клык, рог и т.п.) существа достигает неба, другая волочится по земле

description_en: A house stands on one or several bird’s legs and/or is turning (capable to turn)
description_en_google: Describes a house that stands on bird's feet or one leg and / or rotates (can rotate)
description_ru: Описывается дом, который стоит на птичьих ногах или одной ноге и/или вращается (способен поворачиваться)

description_en: Two or four boys go to war or are on their way home. A long serpent-like creature blocks the passage, they cannot find a path around it and burn it through. One eats its roasted meat and turns into serpent himself or dies
description_en_google: Two or four young men go hiking or return. Their path is blocked by a long creature that cannot be avoided. They burn a passage in it. One eats baked meat, turns into a snake or dies
description_ru: Двое или четверо юношей идут в поход или возвращаются. Их путь преграждает длинное существо, которое нельзя обойти. Они прожигают в нем проход. Один ест испеченное мясо, сам превращается в змея или умирает

description_en: Person escapes to a tree or high rock. An ogre tries to cut it down. An animal suggests the ogre to have a rest, promises to work instead of him but spoils his work
description_en_google: A demon, an ogre, cuts down a tree or rock, on top of which the hero hid. The animal offers the ogre to chop instead for him to rest, and instead spoils his work, saving the hero
description_ru: Демон, людоед рубит дерево или скалу, на вершине которой спрятался герой. Животное предлагает людоеду рубить вместо него, чтобы тот отдохнул, а вместо этого портит его работу, спасая героя

description_en: Person escapes to a tree or a high rock. An ogre tries to cut it down. While the ogre has a rest, an animal throws his axe into the water or carries it away
description_en_google: A demon, an ogre, cuts down a tree or rock, on top of which the hero hid. While he is resting, the animal throws his ax into the water, carries it away or spoils it.
description_ru: Демон, людоед рубит дерево или скалу, на вершине которой спрятался герой. Пока он отдыхает, животное выбрасывает его топор в воду, уносит или портит его

description_en: Cunning fox, jackal or coyote saves particular person or many people, helps them
description_en_google: A fox, a jackal or a coyote, resorting to tricks, helps the hero, heroine or people in general, saves them
description_ru: Лиса, шакал или койот, прибегая к хитрости, помогает герою, героине или людям вообще, спасает их

description_en: Cunning rabbit or hare saves person, helps him or her
description_en_google: Hare or rabbit, resorts to cunning, helps the hero or heroine, rescues them
description_ru: Заяц или кролик, прибегает к хитрости, помогает герою или героине, спасает их

description_en: A demon helps a man or a woman or lets him or her free. As a reward, the person is forced to promise to give the demon his child
description_en_google: A demon or an animal helps a person or agrees to let him go, but for this he takes from him a promise to give him a daughter or son (often asks to give what he doesn’t know at home or that he will come first to meet - this is a son born during the absence of the father)
description_ru: Демон или животное помогает человеку или соглашается его отпустить, но за это берет с него обещание отдать ему дочь или сына (часто просит отдать то, что тот дома не знает или что первым выйдет навстречу – это оказывается сын, родившийся во время отсутствия отца)

description_en: A man, stooping down to water, is caught and held by his beard, and has to give the promise in order to be relieved
description_en_google: When a man leans towards the water, the demon grabs his beard and lets go of his promise to fulfill his demand.
description_ru: Когда человек наклоняется к воде, демон хватает его за бороду и отпускает за обещание выполнить его требование

name_en: Coming back to pick up toys
description_en: Person (usually a kid or lad) returns to the former place to pick up the forgotten object (often a toy) and is caught there by a demonic being
description_en_google: A person (usually a child or a teenager) returns to his former place behind a forgotten object (often a toy) and finds a demon from there that he runs away
description_ru: Человек (обычно ребенок или подросток) возвращается на прежнее место за забытым предметом (часто игрушкой) и находит там демона, от которого с трудом убегает

description_en: A lung or a liver lies on a road or floats in a pond etc. As soon as person touches them, a dangerous demon appears in front of him
description_en_google: A person sees the lungs or liver lying on the ground or floating in the water. As soon as he touches them, a demonic character appears in front of him.
description_ru: Человек видит лежащие на земле или плавающие в воде легкие или печень. Как только он касается их, перед ним появляется демонический персонаж

name_en: Sold in animal’s guise and comes back
description_en: Person can transform himself or herself into an animal or an object. Being sold in this guise, he or she achieves his or her aims and becomes a human again
description_en_google: The character has the ability to turn into animals or objects. Being sold in this form, reaches the goal and again becomes a person
description_ru: Персонаж обладает способностью превращаться в животных или предметы. Будучи проданным в этом облике, достигает цели и снова становится человеком

description_en: When person sighs or utters an interjection, another one (usually a demon) emerges because his name is spelled like Ahh, Ohhoi, etc.
description_en_google: The man sighs, after which a character appears with the name Oh, phew, hey-wai, etc.
description_ru: Человек вздыхает, после чего появляется персонаж с именем Ох, Уф, Эй-вай и т.п.

name_en: The yogi boiled in his own pot of oil
name_en_google: Ascetic being pushed into a cauldron
description_en: A man comes into the power of a yogi or demon. He asks the man to walk round the boiling pot of oil or to prostrate himself before the image of a deity. The man asks him to show how to do it and pushes him in or the pot or beheads him
description_en_google: The man gets to the ascetic, demon, etc. He is going to kill him, pushed into a boiling cauldron or chopped off his head when a man bows down before a deity. The person asks the ascetic to do everything first, pushes him into the cauldron himself or chops off his head
description_ru: Человек попадает к аскету, демону и т.п. Тот собирается его убить, столкнув в кипящий котел или отрубив голову, когда человек преклонит ее перед божеством. Человек просит аскета исполнить все первым, сам сталкивает его в котел или отрубает голову

description_en: A human being cannot move because the lower part of his body is rooted into the ground, stuck to it, or is absent at all
description_en_google: The character is deprived of the ability to move from the spot, because the bottom of his body has grown into the ground, has turned to stone, is completely absent, and so on.
description_ru: Персонаж лишен способности сдвинуться с места, поскольку низ его тела врос в землю, окаменел, вовсе отсутствует, и т.п.

description_en: Dangerous cannibal or bush spirit who abducts children, attacks people, etc. is associated with an owl
description_en_google: A demon that takes children, threatens heroes, people, etc., is an owl, owl; there is a race of owls hostile to people
description_ru: Демоном, который уносит детей, угрожает героям, людям и т.п., является филин, сова; есть раса сов, враждебная людям

name_en: Bring me a spit to roast you!
description_en: An ogre sends a man to bring him a roasting stick and/or firewood to cook him. The man intentionally does it slowly, brings unfit objects An ogre sends a man to bring a roasting stick and/or firewood to cook him. The man intentionally does it slowly, brings unfit objects or a an animal helps him to escape
description_en_google: Having caught a character, the ogre orders him to bring wood or spit to fry him. The character intentionally lags, brings not what is needed, or some animal helps him to escape
description_ru: Поймав персонажа, людоед велит, чтобы тот сам принес дрова или вертел зажарить его. Персонаж намеренно мешкает, приносит не то, что нужно, либо какое-то животное помогает ему спастись

description_en: Person's leg is injured intentionally or by chance. The loss of one leg does not bother him. He uses the sharpened bone as a thrust weapon
description_en_google: The character's leg is crippled (intentionally or accidentally) or initially pointed. He uses a pointed bone as a piercing weapon.
description_ru: Нога персонажа покалечена (намеренно или случайно) или изначально заострена. Он использует заостренную кость в качестве колющего орудия

description_en: Person's sharp elbows or (rare) knees are like awls or knives
description_en_google: Sharp elbows of a character are like knives or awls
description_ru: Острые локти персонажа подобны ножам или шильям

description_en: Person has a sharp axe-like protrusion on his breast
description_en_google: Character kills others with a cusp
description_ru: Персонаж убивает других острым выступом на груди

description_en: Person has sharp nails or knife-like hands to kill people
description_en_google: The character has sharp nails or hands-knives with which he kills people.
description_ru: У персонажа острые ногти или руки-ножи, которыми он убивает людей

description_en: Anthropomorphic character has nose of copper or iron
description_en_google: The anthropomorphic character nose copper or iron
description_ru: У антропоморфного персонажа нос медный или железный

description_en: A girl or a woman who was stuck in a tree-hollow when she tried to extract honey or who was greedily sucking honey otherwise, dies or turns into the honey or into the bee
description_en_google: A girl or woman gets stuck in a hollow, extracting honey, or eagerly sucks honey in some other way and as a result dies or undergoes a metamorphosis; a woman stuck in a narrow passage turns into honey, into a honey bee
description_ru: Девушка или женщина застревает в дупле, извлекая мед, либо жадно сосет мед иным образом и в результате гибнет или претерпевает метаморфозу; застрявшая в узком проходе женщина превращается в мед, в медовую пчелу

name_en: Sleep at the edge of a cliff
description_en: One animal-person suggests another to lie asleep at the edge of a bluff or cliff. At night he tells him to move a little, the companion falls down and dies
description_en_google: One of the characters encourages the other to go to sleep on the edge of a cliff. At night, he proposes to move, his companion falls, breaks
description_ru: Один из персонажей подговаривает другого лечь спать на краю обрыва. Ночью он предлагает подвинуться, его спутник падает, разбивается

description_en: An animal-person provokes another to jump from of a bluff or cliff (tree) because his father (grandfather, etc.) could do it. The one yielded to provocation jumps and dies or is caught by the provoker
description_en_google: One of the characters encourages the other to jump from a high cliff or tree, for it is alleged that the ancestor of the other did. Another jumps, breaks or falls into the paws of the first
description_ru: Один из персонажей подговаривает другого прыгнуть с высокой скалы или дерева, ибо так, якобы, поступал предок другого. Другой прыгает, разбивается или попадает в лапы первого

name_en: Some are afraid of men, and some of partridges
name_en_google: Who is afraid of people, and who partridges
name_ru: Кто боится людей, а кто куропаток
description_en: One animal (the fox, rare sable or wolf) tells that he is afraid of the men, another (the bear) that of the partridges when they fly up suddenly. When Bear attacks a man, he is wounded or killed, Cf. motif M101A
description_en_google: One character (a fox, rarely a sable, a wolf) admits that he is afraid of people, and another (a bear) - that the partridges are flying. Having tried to attack people, the bear was killed or wounded. Wed motif M101A
description_ru: Один персонаж (лиса, редко соболь, волк) признается, что боится людей, а другой (медведь) - что влетающих куропаток. Попытавшись напасть на людей, медведь убит или ранен. Ср. мотив M101A

description_en: A big predator (bear, lion, tiger) boasts about being stronger than a man. Being told that it’s not so, he finds a man and suggests to struggle but is killed or badly injured as a result. Cf. motif M101
description_en_google: Having learned that a person is supposedly stronger than him, a large predator finds a person and offers to measure themselves with force. It ends for him pitiably. Wed motif M101
description_ru: Узнав, что человек, якобы, сильнее его, крупный хищник находит человека и предлагает помериться силой. Это заканчивается для него плачевно. Ср. мотив M101

name_en: Three men: the former, the future, the present one
description_en: A big predator is eager to see a man. He comes across a boy but gets to know that he will be a man later, then an old person who is not a man anymore. The encounter with the real man (hunter, soldier) has for the animal the unpleasant consequences
description_en_google: A large predator wants to see a man. First he meets the child and finds out that this is a future person, then an old man - a former person. Meeting with a real person (hunter, soldier) ends badly for the beast
description_ru: Крупный хищник хочет увидеть человека. Сперва встречает ребенка и узнает, что это будущий человек, затем старика – бывшего человека. Встреча с настоящим человеком (охотником, солдатом) кончается для зверя плачевно

name_en: Person lets his leg or head to be cut off
description_en: A bird stands with one leg tucked under it, putting its head under its wing; turtle draws its head and limbs under its shell. Person decides that the bird has one leg, no head, turtle has neither head nor limbs, asks to cut him his head and limbs off
description_en_google: The character believes that the other has temporarily separated his head or leg from himself, asks him to do the same, is killed or crippled
description_ru: Персонаж верит, что другой на время отделил от себя свои голову или ногу, просит так же поступить с ним, гибнет или искалечен

description_en: Person asks another how her or his children got their pretty colors. Another answers that she or he put them into the fire. roasted, etc. The first person believes, kills his or her children
description_en_google: One character asks another how her (his) children acquired valuable qualities (became beautiful, obedient, etc.). That or that answers that children should be baked in ashes, kept on fire, set on fire, etc. The first makes her or his children die or are crippled.
description_ru: Один персонаж спрашивает другого, как ее (его) дети приобрели ценные качества (стали красивыми, послушными и т.п.). Та или тот отвечает, что детей надо запечь в золе, держать в огне, прижечь и т.п. Первый так и делает ее или его дети гибнут или покалечены

description_en: Person conceals his or her close relatives (children, mother, brothers) and tells another that he or she has killed them. Another believes and agrees to kill his or her own children, mother, etc.
description_en_google: The character suggests another to kill someone from their close relatives (children, brothers, mother), hides his own, says that he killed them. When the other really kills his relatives, it turns out that the children (mother) of the first one are alive and well.
description_ru: Персонаж предлагает другому убить кого-то из их близких родственников (детей, братьев, мать), прячет своих, уверяет, что убил их. Когда другой действительно убивает своих родственников, оказывается, что дети (мать) первого живы и здоровы

description_en: Person conceals his mother or (rare) wife or mother-in-law, tells another that he has killed or sold her, another really kills or sells his mother (wife, mother-in-law)
description_en_google: The character hides his mother (wife, mother-in-law), but tells another that he killed or sold her, or defiantly leads to sell, but lets him run
description_ru: Персонаж прячет свою мать (жену, тещу), но говорит другому, что убил или продал ее, либо демонстративно ведет продавать, но дает убежать

description_en_google: The character hides his children, but tells another that he killed them, he believes
description_ru: Персонаж прячет своих детей, но говорит другому, что убил их, тот верит

description_en: Person lies that his name is so and so. His enemy, victim or other people, demons or animals understand it not as a name but as a common word and behave accordingly
description_en_google: The character calls himself a made-up name, which the rest understand not as proper, but as common noun with a certain meaning
description_ru: Персонаж называет себя выдуманным именем, которое остальные понимают не как собственное, а как нарицательное с определенным значением

name_en_google: "I myself" and "Nobody" in the house of the demon
description_en: After doing damage or injury to his antagonist, person lies that his name is so and so. Other demons understand it not as a name but as a common word and it makes them believe that the injured one was the trouble-maker himself
description_en_google: The character who caused the damage to the antagonist, calls himself a made-up name like "Nobody", "I myself", etc .; hearing the name of the culprit, other antagonists decide that the victim himself is to blame for what happened
description_ru: Персонаж, причинивший ущерб антагонисту, называет себя выдуманным именем типа «Никто», «Я Сам» и т.п.; услышав имя виновного, другие антагонисты решают, что пострадавший сам виноват в том, что случилось

name_en_google: "Last year" in the house of the demon
description_en: After doing damage or injury to his antagonist, person lies that his name is so and so. Other demons understand it not as a name but as a common word and it makes them believe that the injury had been done so long ago that there is no sense to investigate the case
description_en_google: The character who caused the damage to the antagonist, calls himself a made-up name like "Last year", while other antagonists understand it as if everything happened for a long time and there is no point in looking
description_ru: Персонаж, причинивший ущерб антагонисту, называет себя выдуманным именем типа «В прошлом году», а другие антагонисты понимают это так, будто все случилось давно и искать виноватого не имеет смысла

description_en: Person lies that his name is “The Guest” or so and eats all the food suggested to the guests
description_en_google: Having said that his name is “Guest”, the character takes all the food intended for many guests
description_ru: Сказав, что его имя «Гость», персонаж забирает себе всю предназначенную многим гостям еду

description_en: Person deceives other people telling them that his name is “Son-in-law” or the like. His victims do not find sympathy because his behavior is acceptable if he is a member of the family
description_en_google: Having said that his name is “Son-in-law” (“Husband”, “Uncle”, etc.), the character deceives others. Victims find no sympathy, since as a relative he has the right to behave accordingly.
description_ru: Сказав, что его зовут «Зять» («Муж», «Дядя» и т.п.), персонаж обманывает других. Пострадавшие не находят сочувствия, поскольку на правах родственника он имеет право соответствующим образом себя вести

description_en: A man has accumulated a store of provisions (saved some money, etc.) and tells his wife that it is for the long winter (Christmas, emergencies, etc.). A trickster (beggar) comes to the woman and tells her that his name is Long Winter, etc. She gives him the provisions
description_en_google: The man says that stocks are made for the winter, in case of need, etc. In the absence of the owner, a person comes into the house claiming that his name is Winter (Ramadan, Necessity, etc.). The woman thinks that her husband meant this man, and gives him all the supplies
description_ru: Человек говорит, что запасы сделаны на зиму, на случай необходимости и т.п. В отсутствие хозяина в дом заходит человек, утверждающий, что его имя Зима (Рамадан, Необходимость и т.п.). Женщина думает, что муж имел в виду этого человека, и отдает ему все запасы

description_en: A stranger tells a woman that he comes from the other world and had seen there her dead relative. The woman gives him money and goods for the latter. Usually when her husband goes after the trickster to retrieve the money, the trickster steals his horse
description_en_google: The stranger tells the woman that he came from the next world.
